evidence: main_0057.c:47429-47479 selects one of two global 32-bit slots via arg2 bit 0, stores arg0 there and rebuilds a two-column halfword index when arg1 changes. It then dispatches selected/default/invalid results to three update helpers at 47536-47607 and updates side-specific status at 47609-47656. Caller main_0050.c:2950-2959 invokes both sides consecutively. The selected object's domain remains unresolved.

main_0052.c:914-944 stores arg1 at destination+0x110, resolves its record and copies 0xb0 plus 0xf4 bytes into destination+0x118 and +0x1c8. The +0x48 or default attribute block is copied to +0x318 at 945-966, and a separate resolved block to +0x2bc at 1034-1048. Two derived flags are updated and a follow-on function called at 989-1003 and 1071-1089. Caller main_0031.c:50608-50612 passes the destination, handle and zero option.

evidence: main_0171.c:9288-9325 resolves the player record, obtains its integer attribute using the requested ID, and returns its unadjusted value when category is zero or outside the checked range. The adjustment path reads subject category and a normalized byte, then applies selector-dependent multipliers including clamped linear remaps at 9327-9415 and 9886-9935; converts back to signed integer at 9942. Caller main_0007.c:16624-16634 passes two attribute IDs and stores w0 as 32-bit results.

evidence: main_0034.c:20454-20498 checks player and output pointers, computes byte capacity, copies two name components from the underlying record at +0x50 and +0x60 and extracts the first component's initial. Style dispatch combines components or selects one at 20496-20539; 20540-20604 measures candidates against s0 and shortens with an ellipsis. Exact NSO formats %s. %s, %s %s, %s and %s... at 0x7001d20e90, 0x7001d4dfcf, 0x7001cb3a2d and 0x7001c7d5cb. Terminates at 20854-20855. Caller main_0036.c:9601-9606 passes a player handle, style 1, stack output, capacity 0x40, and float zero.

main_0016.c:13228-13261 resolves player/stat records and optionally prepares a record. The routine reads many player attributes and assembles bat-event and batting line text: exact NSO strings %d for %d at 0x7001d035ff (main_0016.c:13864), Two-Run Home Run at 0x7001d7817c (13941), %d RBI (14184), and Sacrifice Fly (14493), among others. It copies selected text into the output addressed through incoming x8 at 13234 and 14558-14562. Caller main_0108.c:38832-38839 passes the context at +0x348 and consumes the resulting byte string.

main_0100.c:45467-45520 returns -1 for disabled state, disallowed status, null source, absent role byte or failed out-record lookup. Success adds signed low-halfword arg2 to unsigned record+0x0c halfword, picks a player attribute sub-block by context status, and adds truncated player attribute ID 5 at 45501-45530. Caller main_0100.c:37314-37321 sets arg2=0 and compares the integer result against 2999 and 3999.

main_0170.c:11887-11912 validates the output buffer/capacity, reads the nested attribute at owner+0x68 or uses zero. At 11913-11946 it chooses a numeric style from the attribute ID and tail-calls the formatter with the value in s0, output in x0 and capacity in x1. The tail target main_0170.c:50735-50863 selects formatting and terminates the buffer. Caller main_0036.c:41146-41155 provides an attribute ID and 32-byte output used by a subsequent routine.
